comparison_scope: One 136 x 106 illustrative colour region; same canvas and RGB channels. No scientific, typography or whole-figure score.
renderer: Sharp / librsvg; version recorded in VALIDATION.md
candidate_settings: Same fit_svg_region.py implementation with interpolation ending at the next sampled row. Grid size varied; the 27 x 21 output is reproducible with the CLI.
visual_observations: Denser sampling retains more small colour boundaries and reduces visible sampling bands; slight smoothing remains. The larger SVG has more gradient stops and a higher editing burden. No pixel-identical or universally best conversion is claimed.
edit_verification: verify_demo.py saved a new SVG, reparsed the actual file and verified live label, component fill and arrow-position changes. Sharp exported its PNG and the executing agent visually inspected it. This was a source-level test, not an application UI round trip.
